scope: User-authorized existing-model native CLI versus canonical DM; two-Agent Raft versus RAH channel comparison. Not the fixed-model release gate.

timing.native: Process spawn to complete structured answer; CLI startup included.
timing.dm: Durable Human message timestamp to explicit durable Agent message timestamp.
timing.raft: DOM last-absent/first-present interval, including browser send interval; gaps retained.
timing.sessionDifference: Native fresh temporary cwd and session; DM existing canonical context with prefer_resume. Not isolated middleware overhead.
